name: Highest Fame
desc: Islanders with the highest fame.
rules: Buying fame is permitted
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Lowest Fame
desc: Islanders with the lowest fame.
rules: Buying defames is permitted
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Most Lemons
desc: Islanders who own the most lemons. (The only source of lemons on-island is the Mai's Training questline)
rules: Trading is permitted
Lemons may be stored on the contender's island mules
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Most Coolers Logged
desc: Islanders who cracked the most summer coolers and logged the results.
rules: Cooler openings must be documented by screenshots
Coolers opened on island mules and alts count toward total
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Most Chairs
desc: Islanders who own the greatest number of unique chairs.
rules: Donor chairs don't count toward total
Trading is permitted
Chairs may be stored on the contender's island mules
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Most Pig Heads
desc: Islanders who own the most pig heads.
rules: Trading is permitted
Heads may be stored on the contender's island mules
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Pink Bean's Birthday Challenge
desc: Fastest Anniversary Jump Quest Time.
rules: JQ may be completed on the contender's mule
Transformation items are permitted
Time is measured by in-game time given by the NPC
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Halloween Challenge
desc: Fastest Halloween Jump Quest Time.
rules: JQ may be completed on the contender's mule
Transformation items are permitted
Time is measured by in-game time given by the NPC
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Maple Island Speedrun (Clean)
desc: Fastest time to complete Maple Island with a new character.
rules: A new character must be used
Run time uses the in-game clock
Time starts at the first full-brightness frame on fade-in entering the training camp balcony
Time ends at the last full-brightness frame before the boat cutscene
Trading is not permitted
Pre-farming maps for mob placement is not permitted (just be cool mmkay?)
Cash shop items are not permitted
Partying is not permitted

name: Maple Island Speedrun (Assisted)
desc: Fastest time to complete Maple Island with a new character.
rules: A new character must be used
Run time uses the in-game clock
Time starts at the first full-brightness frame on fade-in entering the training camp balcony
Time ends at the last full-brightness frame before the boat cutscene
Trading is permitted
Pre-farming maps for mob placement is permitted
Cash shop items are permitted
Partying and leeching is permitted

name: Max Damage
desc: Highest max damage.
rules: Damage is ranked by max damage as listed in character stats
Any gear is permitted (and gear can be borrowed)
Weather buffs are the only buffs permitted
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Min Damage
desc: Highest minimum damage.
rules: Damage is ranked by min damage as listed in character stats
Any gear is permitted (and gear can be borrowed)
Weather buffs are the only buffs permitted
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Average Damage (INTlander)
desc: Highest Damage Range for INTlanders, Magelanders, and NoPointers (No AP in STR or DEX)
rules: Damage is ranked by average of min and max damage as listed in character stats
Any gear is permitted (and gear can be borrowed)
Weather buffs are the only buffs permitted
Contender must reside on Maple Island

name: Best Gomus
desc: Highest stat scrolled white gomushins
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by (speed+jump) with wdef as a tiebreaker

name: Best Beach Slippers
desc: Highest stat scrolled beach slippers (available only from summer cooler boxes)
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by (speed+jump) with str+dex+int+luk as a tiebreaker

name: Best Lv.0 Shoes
desc: Highest stat scrolled Lv.0 shoes (Leather Sandals, Red/Yellow/Blue Rubber Boots)
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by (speed+jump) with wdef as a tiebreaker

name: Best Broomstick
desc: Highest speed broomstick (Available during Halloween Event)
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by speed with watk as a tiebreaker

name: Best Witch Hat
desc: Highest stat Talking Witch Hat (Available during Halloween Event)
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by str+dex+int+luk

name: Best Shirt
desc: Highest stat scrolled topwear.
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by wdef

name: Best Pants
desc: Highest stat scrolled bottomwear.
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by wdef

name: Best Vanilla Hat
desc: Highest stat scrolled hat. (Not including Witch Hats)
rules: Item must currently exist on maple island
Items are ranked by wdef
